subject.title: [Feature]: expose QMD reranker candidate limit in memory config

question: Should OpenClaw add an operator-facing `memory.qmd.limits.candidateLimit` configuration key, or should QMD reranking remain controlled only by the existing rerank and timeout settings?
rationale: This is an additive user configuration surface rather than repair of an established broken contract, and repository policy sets a high bar for adding configuration options.

options.title: Accept the narrow QMD control
options.body: Sponsor the linked PR if review confirms the QMD CLI and MCP paths honor the same optional value and existing users retain unchanged behavior when it is unset.

options.title: Keep the current config surface
options.body: Decline the additional key if existing rerank or timeout controls are considered the supported operational policy despite the narrower QMD-native control.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow QMD control
recommendation.body: Sponsor the linked PR if review confirms the QMD CLI and MCP paths honor the same optional value and existing users retain unchanged behavior when it is unset.

likelyOwner.reason: The only concrete associated person in the available evidence can clarify the proposed contract and proof; final product sponsorship should be supplied through normal memory-area PR review.
